items.says: Education appears before experience even though the work history better establishes the candidate's career direction.
The consulting practicum repeats the same scheduling-pilot outcome in both the financial-model and presentation bullets.
The onboarding bullet attributes the reduction in median time to the redesign without establishing causation.
The checkout test is presented as causing the conversion increase without stating that it was properly randomized and analyzed.
The phrase 'the three-step flow' repeats 'flow' without adding much distinction after 'one-page flow.'
The phrase 'success metrics' does not state what outcome the metrics recorded.
The chargeback-loss estimate does not identify whose losses were measured.
The result of the chargeback analysis is delayed until after the methods and is expressed indirectly.
The dollar amount is written less concisely than standard résumé currency format.
The bullet implies that weekly triage caused the open-ticket queue to fall by half.
The phrase 'the onboarding results' does not identify which result leadership used to justify the rollout.
The late-delivery reduction is attributed to the scorecard rebuild and related renegotiations without establishing causation.
The pick-error reduction is attributed to the bundled slotting and retraining intervention without establishing causation, and its 30% measure is undefined.
The forecast-error reduction does not define the error measure or establish that the two figures are comparable.
The forecast-review bullet repeats its quarterly cadence.
The abbreviation 'S&OP' is unexplained jargon for readers outside operations.
The annual saving of 1,800 driver hours does not state whether it was measured, projected, annualized, or how it was calculated.
The 1,800-hour result is buried after the rollout and training details.
The app-launch bullet identifies the release but not the product work performed as Product Lead.
The phrase 'with two dining halls' ambiguously modifies either the app's launch or the 3,100 students.
The phrase 'that would have been thrown away' adds a long passive clause instead of stating the recovered-food result directly.
The volunteer-shift bullet describes the system but not the specific product or operating work performed to create it.
The phrase 'with two dining halls' does not clarify whether the shift system served both halls or was created in partnership with them.
The bullet repeats the weekly cadence in both the pickup-slot and staff-cover results.
The claim that the two-page form retained all required fields is not supported by the stated mapping method.
The intake-mapping method is not specific enough to show how the process was analyzed.
The presentation bullet shows the communication step but not the analytical or decision-support work behind the recommendation.
The strongest result—the approved pilot—is buried after the presentation details.
